title: AI Tool to Create Optimized and Animatable BlockyModel Assets for Hytale/Minecraft/Etc
author: TheRealArthur
selftext:
This is Myrlin, a tool/pipeline I built for making blocky models from a prompt or reference image. I've just released Studio 2 after rebuilding how the original creates the models. 

The whole process is streamlined - you enter a description or image + description, and the pipeline goes through and makes a proper blockymodel asset. Theres also an integrated animation/effects tool that to do either via prompt to an asset on your account, AND a workbench if you want to do some touch ups to a model before exporting.  
  
Its not just a glb that gets filled volumetrically  with cubes and greedy algorithm optimized. It creates proper, purposefully placed (and more importantly, properly named and grouped) cubes/boxes/quads - and textures them with a uv that is sectioned properly the way a real modeler would.

For example, a furnace golem I made has 60 boxes, with its head, arms, hands and legs in separate groups. A salvage helicopter has 57 boxes and 5 flat pieces, with its cockpit, rotors and winch grouped too. If you want to change a rotor, you can find that part in the tree and work on it.

I'm also working on generating a coherently themed set of assets from one project brief. Something like staffs, wands and equipment for a magic mod, or a family of different dragons. That part is still in progress, but it's where I want to take this next.

If you're making a mod or need blocky assets for a project, I'd love to see what you make with it [forge.myrlin.io](https://forge.myrlin.io/).

Would appreciate feedback either here or on the website (I have a feedback bubble on every page), and would love to see what you guys can make with this!
